title: Halozyme to Report Second Quarter 2026 Financial and Operating Results
summary: Halozyme Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: HALO) ("Halozyme") today announced it will release its second quarter 2026 financial and operating results on Thursday, August 6, 2026, following the close of trading. Halozyme will host a conference call on Thursday, August 6, 2026 at 1:30pm PT/4:30pm ET to discuss the results. The conference call may be accessed live with pre-registration via this link: https://events.q4inc.com/analyst/838122249?pwd=X5tkHKiy A live webcast and replay of the conference call will also be available through the "Investors" section of Halozyme's corporate website at www.halozyme.com . About Halozyme Halozyme is a biopharmaceutical company advancing disruptive solutions to improve patient experiences and outcomes for emerging and established therapies.
